authority: Original fictional US facility quality lead, 2026-10-20 09:00 America/New_York. Not an FDA approval requirement.
source_scope: Four exact model/UDI pairs explicitly listed in frozen S01; not the unavailable complete affected-product workbook and not all Philips recalls.
identity_rule: A known model whose UDI differs or is missing remains HOLD_IDENTITY. Never silently overwrite an identity from a generic product label.
service_evidence_rule: Use only service records at the frozen as_of observation and authority primary. Multiple such records with different installed versions remain HOLD_SERVICE_CONFLICT; do not choose by ticket order or late email. A note is not a replacement record.
required_internal_checks: at least one primary same-observation service record; all agree; installed version exactly the stated frozen US target
current manufacturer addendum checked according to the given internal register
known historical sensor-deposit concern has a checked service resolution; unknown history requires clarification
for transferred assets, actual current-recipient acknowledgement of the updated notice and addendum in the given register
priority_rule: identity hold before service conflict before other missing gates; retain transfer followup separately. No priority order is an instruction to stop a patient's ventilator.
other_versions: Do not numerically order firmware or force a downgrade. A different version, including 1.06.15.00, needs US model/channel-specific clinical-engineering/manufacturer confirmation; it does not prove completion.
status_note: READY_FOR_AUTHORIZED_REVIEW is an internal evidence handoff only, never final clinical authorization. Case records are fictional task facts, not genuine supplier certificates.
